body:
Good catch !
PR appreciated (please follow the guidelines in #11221, ie modify the generator instead of the generated code). Thanks.
@vicb Unexpectedly, `HTMLTimeElement` is not implemented on Chrome.

yep

```
t = document.createElement('time')
t.constructor
HTMLUnknownElement() { [native code] }

p = document.createElement('p')
p.constructor
HTMLParagraphElement() { [native code] }
```

Could you submit a PR to manually add `time` to the extractor + regenerate the file.

Then [the idea](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/96697029c9993ac8e99e61e222547fb58b472f8a/modules/%40angular/compiler/test/schema/schema_extractor.ts#L160) is to generate the map (switch/case) dynamically by using all the els listed in the html5 specs - this is more work and longer term .
